QuestInfo.name: Anniversary : Birthday Present (Red)
QuestInfo.0: I should go visit the MapleStory Administrator. I heard MapleStory is celebrating its 1st birthday, and she may have something in store for me...
QuestInfo.1: The MapleStory Administrator said we'll be celebrating the anniversary in style and that there is a #bRED birthday present#k for me to look for. Now, where must that be...\n\n#t4031306# #b#c4031306#/1#k
QuestInfo.2: I found the #bRED birthday present#k and gave it to the Maple Administrator. She opened the present for me, and gave me what was inside. That was pretty sweet!

0.0: MapleStory is nearing its very first birthday, and we're going to celebrate it in style! I have a new, anniversary-related quest for you. Would you like to do it?

yes.0: Here's the deal. Please bring a #bRED birthday present#k to me, and I'll help you open it. Deal? I'll see you later.

no.0: I see. Please remember that this event ends soon, so if you want to take a crack at it later, then please talk to me!

1.0: Wow, that was pretty fast! Aren't you ready to open up your present?

yes.0: Tada. Here's your present! Hope you like what you see in it! Thank you so much for helping us celebrate MapleStory's first birthday!

item.0: I don't think you have the #bRED Birthday Present#k yet. Please bring it to me, so I can help you open it!
